examples.query: And tasting those things, the glorious one took them for fruits, never tasted before by the dwellers of the forest.
examples.gold_sn: तानि चास्वाद्य तेजस्वी फलानीति स्म मन्यते। अनास्वादितपूर्वाणि वने नित्यनिवासिनाम्॥

examples.query: And that Rākṣasa of dreadful form daily frightens people. And, O descendant of Raghu, Tātakā of wicked deeds, daily commits havoc upon these countries, Maladã and Karuşă.
examples.gold_sn: राक्षसो भैरवाकारो नित्यं त्रासयते प्रजाः। इमौ जनपदौ नित्यं विनाशयति राघव ॥ मलदांश्च करूषांश्च ताटका दुष्टचारिणी।

examples.query: And, O Raghava, when Brahmadatta was married, that sonless one, (Kušanābha), with the intention of obtaining male offspring, took in hand a son-conferring sacrifice.
examples.gold_sn: कृतोद्वाहे गते तस्मिन् ब्रह्मदत्ते च राघव। अपुत्रः पुत्रलाभाय पौत्रीमिष्टिमकल्पयत्॥

examples.query: And when the sacrifice had commenced, that son of Brahmā, the exceedingly noble Kusa, spoke to king Kusanābha, saying,
examples.gold_sn: इष्टयां तु वर्तमानायां कुशनाभं महीपतिम्। उवाच परमोदारैः कुशो ब्रह्मसुतस्तदा॥

examples.query: And that virtuous Kausiki, Satyavati, as well established in religion as truth, and chaste, and eminently pious, is now the foremost of streams.
examples.gold_sn: सा तु सत्यवती पुण्या सत्ये धर्मे प्रतिष्ठिता। पतिव्रता महाभागा कौशिकी सरितां वरा॥

examples.query: O son, let my sons having noble forms, becoming famous Marutas range the Vātaskandha regions in heaven.
examples.gold_sn: वातस्कन्धा इमे सप्त चरन्तु दिवि पुत्रक। मारुता इति विख्याता दिव्यरूपा ममात्मजाः॥

examples.query: Summoning his disciples, he said, 'Do you by my command bring hither all the saints together with Vasistha's sons; and our friends and their disciples an the family priests variously versed in lore.'
examples.gold_sn: सर्वाशिष्यान् समाहूय वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह। सर्वानृषीन् सवासिष्ठानानयध्वं ममाज्ञया॥ सशिष्यान् सुहृदश्चैव सर्विजः सुबहुश्रुतान्।

examples.query: Forsaking the northern direction the mighty Muni, O Rāma, betaking himself to the Eastern quarter, became engaged in dreadful austerities.
examples.gold_sn: अथ हैमवतीं राम दिशं त्यक्त्वा महामुनिः। पूर्वां दिशमनुप्राप्य तपस्तेपे सुदारुणम्॥

examples.query: And having brought that bow plaited with iron, placed in its case, the royal counsellors spoke to Janaka resembling an immortal, saying,
examples.gold_sn: तामादाय सुमञ्जूषामायसीं यत्र तद्धनुः। सुरोपमं ते जनकमूचुर्नृपतिमन्त्रिणः॥

examples.query: My highly energetic, puissant and eminently righteous brother known by the name of Kusadhvaja dwell in the auspicious city, Sāņkāśyā, whose ramparts are ranged round with pointed weapons, and which is laved by the river Ikşumatī, and which resembles the celestial regions or the aerial car, Pușpaka.
examples.gold_sn: भ्राता मम महातेजा वीर्यवानतिधार्मिकः। कुशध्वज इति ख्यातः पुरीमध्यवसच्छुभाम्॥ वार्याफलकपर्यन्तां पिबन्निक्षुमती नदीम्। सांकाश्यां पुण्यसंकाशां विमानमिव पुष्पकम्॥

examples.query: Mahīdhraka's son was king Kirtirāta endowed with great strength. And the Rājarşi Kirtirāta had Mahāroman born to him.
examples.gold_sn: महीध्रकसुतो राजा कीर्तिरातो महाबलः। कीर्तिरातस्य राजर्षेर्महारोमा व्यजायत॥

examples.query: Do you renounce the ills that come through anger and lust. Replenishing your exchequer and arsenal do you, acquainting yourself with the state of things personally and otherwise, administer justice and thereby enlist the affection of the courtiers and other subjects; for the friends of him that sway the earth, pleasing the people to his satisfaction, rejoice even as did the immortals on obtaining ambrosia.
examples.gold_sn: कामक्रोधसमुत्थानि त्यजस्व व्यसनानि च। परोक्षया वर्तमानो वृत्त्या प्रत्यक्षया तथा॥ अमात्यप्रभृतीः सर्वाः प्रजाश्चैवानुरञ्जय। कोष्ठागारायुधागारैः कृत्वा संनिचयान् बहून्॥ इष्टानुरक्तप्रकृतिर्यः पालयति मेदिनीम्। तस्य नन्दन्ति मित्राणि लब्ध्वामृतमिवामराः॥

examples.query: You did O girl, many a time tell me that Rāma was equal to you with the high-souled Bharata.
examples.gold_sn: ननु ते राघवस्तुल्यो भरतेन महात्मना। बहुशो हि स्म बाले त्वं कथाः कथयसे मम॥

examples.query: Rāghava does not consent, even that would conduce to my pleasure but he will do nothing of the kind.
examples.gold_sn: यदि मे राघवः कुर्याद् वनं गच्छेति चोदितः। प्रतिकूलं प्रियं मे स्यान्न तु वत्सः करिष्यति॥

examples.query: And the worshipful Vasiştha stays with the Brāhmaṇas. Do you, O king, immediately order the installation of Rāma.
examples.gold_sn: अयं वसिष्ठो भगवान् ब्राह्मणैः सह तिष्ठति। क्षिप्रमाज्ञाप्यतां राजन् राघवस्याभिषेचनम्॥

examples.query: Therefore I shall speedily go hence and see my father. Do you remain and enjoy here the company of your friends.
examples.gold_sn: हन्त शीघ्रमितो गत्वा द्रक्ष्यामि च महीपतिम्। सह त्वं परिवारेण सुखमास्व रमस्व च ॥

examples.query: Rāma saw his father, seated on a beautiful sofa with Kaikeyi, looking sorry and poorly and with his countenance dried up.
examples.gold_sn: स ददर्शासने रामो विषण्णं पितरं शुभे। कैकेय्या सहितं दीनं मुखेन परिशुष्यता॥

examples.query: All persons, who were present there and who adorned themselves on account of the installation, did not perceive any sign of mental agony on the face of Rāma.
examples.gold_sn: सर्वोऽप्यभिजनः श्रीमाञ्श्रीमतः सत्यवादिनः। नालक्षयत रामस्य कंचिदाकारमानने॥

examples.query: The female warders honoured Rāma rejoicing, and entering his mother's apartment, communicated to her speedily this pleasant news.
examples.gold_sn: वर्धयित्वा प्रहृष्टास्ताः प्रविश्य च गृहं स्त्रियः। न्यवेदयन्त त्वरितं राममातुः प्रियं तदा॥

examples.query: O best of monarchs, after the fourteen years have been spent, you will see me again by your side, therefore do you banish this grief.
examples.gold_sn: चतुर्दशसु वर्षेषु गतेषु नृपसत्तम। पुनर्द्रक्ष्यसि मां प्राप्तं संतापोऽयं विमुच्यताम्॥

examples.query: Then swiftly causing a car to be yoked, he said to his men, “This one is to be banished for life in proper garb along with his wife.
examples.gold_sn: तं यानं शीघ्रमारोप्य सभार्यं सपरिच्छदम्। यावज्जीवं विवास्योऽयमिति तानन्वशात् पिता ॥

examples.query: Then Dasaratha's son, Rāma, made his bashful wife (in power) inconceivable like to Śrī herself, ascend the raft, and carefully laid beside Vaidehī her attires and ornaments as well as the hoe and the basket.
examples.gold_sn: तत्र श्रियमिवाचिन्त्यां रामो दाशरथिः प्रियाम्। ईषत्स लज्जमानां तामध्यारोपयत प्लवम्॥ पार्वे तत्र च वैदेह्या वसने भूषणानि च। प्लवे कठिनकाजंच रामश्चके समाहितः॥

examples.query: Then they proceeding on foot along with Sītā, arrived at the charming and beautiful mountain Citrakuta.
examples.gold_sn: ततस्तौ पादचारेण गच्छन्तौ सह सीतया। रम्यमासेदतुः शैलं चित्रकूटं मनोरमम् ॥

examples.query: Having, O Kausalyā, earned the expression, 'The Prince can pierce his aim by sound alone,', I, a prince and bowman, did this offence.
examples.gold_sn: लब्धशब्देन कौसल्ये कुमारेण धनुष्मता। कुमारः शब्दवेधीति मया पापमिदं कृतम्॥

examples.query: What can be an object of greater regret than that I during my last moments cannot behold the righteous Rāma having truth for prowess?
examples.gold_sn: अतस्तु किं दुःखतरं यदहं जीवितक्षये॥ नहि पश्यामि धर्मज्ञं रामं सत्यपराक्रमम्।

examples.query: O Kaikeyī, attain you your wished: do you enjoy this kingdom rid of your thorn. O cruel one, O you of wicked ways, you that forsaking the king had set your heart (on having your son crowned), Rāma had gone away, forsaking me; and now my lord has ascended heaven. I can no longer bear to live, like one left lone in a wilderness by her companions.
examples.gold_sn: सकामा भव कैकेयि भुक्ष्व राज्यमकण्टकम्। त्यक्त्वा राजानमेकाना नृशंसे दुष्टचारिणि ॥ विहाय मां गतो रामो भर्ता च स्वर्गतो मम। विपथे सार्थहीनेव नाहं जीवितुमुत्सहे॥

examples.query: Once on a time, it is related by persons cognizant of morality, Surabhi regarded by the celestials, beheld two of her sons toiling on earth and seeming to be deprived of their senses.
examples.gold_sn: अन्यदा किल धर्मज्ञा सुरभिः सुरसम्मता। वहमानौ ददर्शोर्त्यां पुत्रौ विगतचेतसौ॥

examples.query: Even that one yielding whatever is asked, auspicious, crowned with the choicest virtues,। although having all natural functions, showing equal kindness to all, and of unequalled character, who maintain all creatures, she who has a thousand sons, grieves (for her sons). How can then Kausalyā carry on existence without Rāma?
examples.gold_sn: समाप्रतिमवृत्ताया लोकधारणकाम्यया। श्रीमत्या गुणमुख्यायाः स्वभावपरिचेष्टया॥ यस्याः पुत्रसहस्राणि सापि शोचति कामधुक् । किं पुनर्या विना रामं कौसल्या वर्तयिष्यति॥

examples.query: Being raised up, those renowned chiefs of men looked like Indra's banner stained by shine and shower.
examples.gold_sn: उत्थितौ तौ नरव्याघ्रौ प्रकाशेते यशस्विनौ। वर्षातपपरिग्लानौ पृथगिन्द्रध्वजाविव ॥

examples.query: Then her companions in a body took counsel of each other, saying, “considering the way in which he has entered upon it, he will annihilate us quite."
examples.gold_sn: अमन्त्रयत कृत्स्नश्च तस्याः सर्वः सखीजनः। यथायं समुपक्रान्तो निःशेष नः करिष्यति॥

examples.query: And the honourable persons (belonging to all the three orders) went with the object of beholding Rāma in company with Lakşmaņa.
examples.gold_sn: प्रयाताश्चार्यसंघाता रामं द्रष्टुं सलक्ष्मणम्। तस्यैव च कथाश्चित्राः कुर्वाणा हृष्टमानसाः॥

examples.query: And elephants graced with flags ing spurred on by their riders, began to cross the stream, appearing like (so many) winged hills.
examples.gold_sn: सवैजयन्तास्तु गजा गजारोहैः प्रचोदिताः। तरन्तः स्म प्रकाशन्ते सपक्षा इव पर्वताः॥

examples.query: Then with the view of seeing Bharadvāja, that descendent of Raghu leaving behind the counsellors also, went in the wake of the priest.
examples.gold_sn: ततः संदर्शने तस्य भरद्वाजस्य राघवः। मन्त्रिणस्तानवस्थाप्य जगामानुपुरोहितम्॥

examples.query: The dust raised by the hoofs (of horses) stands covering the sky: anon the wind bearing it away, compasses my pleasure.
examples.gold_sn: खुरैरुदीरितो रेणुर्दिवं प्रच्छाद्य तिष्ठति। तं वहत्यनिलः शीघ्रं कुर्वन्निव मम प्रियम्॥

examples.query: And did you spend your wealth in the interests of the deities, or the pitris, or the Brāhmaṇas who have come to you, or warriors, or friends?
examples.gold_sn: देवतार्थे च पित्रर्थे ब्राह्मणाभ्यागतेषु च। योधेषु मित्रवर्गेषु कच्चिद् गच्छति ते व्ययः॥

examples.query: O Rāma, ever happy is the life of him that others depend upon for subsistence: unhappy is the life of the person that depends upon others for support.
examples.gold_sn: सुजीवं नित्यशस्तस्य यः परैरुपजीव्यते। राम तेन तु दुर्जीवं यः परानुपजीवति॥

examples.query: No individual has any one (in the world). As on the eve of setting out for another country, a person stays somewhere (outside the village he lives in), and the next day goes away, renouncing that abode, even such are a man's father and mother, house and wealth. O Kākutstha, worthy people never bear affection towards a mere abode.
examples.gold_sn: यथा ग्रामान्तरं गच्छन् नरः कश्चिद् बहिर्वसेत्। उत्सृज्य च तमावासं प्रतिष्ठेतापरेऽहनि॥ एवमेव मनुष्याणां पिता माता गृहं वसु। आवासमात्रं काकुत्स्थ सज्जन्ते नात्र सज्जनाः॥

examples.query: Other Brāhmaṇas than yourself, superior to you, have, severing this world as well as the next, performed various excellent acts.
examples.gold_sn: त्वत्तो जनाः पूर्वतरे द्विजाश्च शुभानि कर्माणि बहूनि चक्रुः। छित्त्वा सदेमं च परं च लोकं तस्माद् द्विजाः स्वस्ति कृतं हुतं च ॥

examples.query: O Rāghava, although you are vigilant, able, and in all ways capable, it would be unpleasant for you to dwell here now in doubt.
examples.gold_sn: सकलत्रस्य संदेहो नित्यं युक्तस्य राघव। समर्थस्यापि सहितो वासो दुःखमिहाद्य ते॥

examples.query: O you of expansive eyes, be you securing the sumimum bonum, with a joyful heart, become, O superbly beautiful wench, the younger wife of the noble one of great good fortune.
examples.gold_sn: समृद्धार्थस्य सिद्धार्था मुदितामलवर्णिनि। आर्यस्य त्वं विशालाक्षि भार्या भव यवीयसी॥

examples.query: Having said this, even as a mighty meteor strike Rohiņī, that one having eyes resembling live coals, waxing exceedingly enraged, rushed towards that (damsel) with the eyes of a doe.
examples.gold_sn: इत्युक्त्वा मृगशावाक्षीमलातसदृशेक्षणा। अभ्यगच्छत् सुसंक्रुद्धा महोल्का रोहिणीमिव ॥

examples.query: Kankas, Gomayas and vultures, portending fear, began to cry. Ever inauspicious in war, jackals presaging evil, with their mouths belching forth flame, howled in the face of the forces.
examples.gold_sn: कङ्कगोमायुगृध्राश्च चुक्रुशुर्भयशंसिनः। नित्याशिवकरा युद्धे शिवा घोरनिदर्शनाः॥ नेदुर्बलस्याभिमुखं ज्वालोद्गारिभिराननैः।

examples.query: And those loftily edifices had excellent windows made of vory and silver, and covered with golden nets.
examples.gold_sn: दान्तका राजताश्चैव गवाक्षाः प्रियदर्शनाः। हेमजालावृताश्चासंस्तत्र प्रासादपङ्क्तयः॥

examples.query: After Rāma had bewailed thus being beside himself with grief, Saumitrī, ever treading the right path and not of poorly mind spoke words worthy of being said on that occasion.
examples.gold_sn: इतीव तं शोकविधेयदेह रामं विसंज्ञं विलपन्तमेव। उवाच सौमित्रिरदीनसत्त्वो न्याय्ये स्थितः कालयुतं च वाक्यम्॥

examples.query: While proceeding thus, conversing with each other the two brothers beheld some flowers scattered on the high-way.
examples.gold_sn: एवं सम्भाषमाणौ तावन्योन्यं भ्रातरावुभौ॥ वसुंधरायां पतितपुष्पमार्गमपश्यताम्।

examples.query: Repairing with Lakşmaņa to the lake Pampā filled with red and while lotuses and fish Rāma having his senses agitated began to lament.
examples.gold_sn: स तां पुष्करिणीं गत्वा पद्मोत्पलझषाकुलाम्। रामः सौमित्रिसहितो विललापाकुलेन्द्रियः॥

examples.query: Thereat seeing me with one to assist me, and finding that we had come upon him, that mighty Asura, fled, seized with fear. And fleeing on, he (at length) swiftly entered a huge hole.
examples.gold_sn: स तु दृष्टैव मां रात्रौ सद्वितीयं महाबलः॥ प्राद्रवद् भयसंत्रस्तो वीक्ष्यावां समुपागतौ। अभिद्रुतस्तु वेगेन विवेश स महाबिलम्॥

examples.query: By what I myself feel, I see that you had sunk in a sea of sorrow. But I will deliver you; and you shall attain both your wife as well as this kingdom.
examples.gold_sn: आत्मानुमानात् पश्यामि मग्नस्त्वं शोकसागरे। त्वामहं तारयिष्यामि बाढं प्राप्स्यसि पुष्कलम्॥

examples.query: Beholding Rāma approach with Lakşmaņa, Sugrīva, stricken with shame and casting his looks on the earth, addressed him poorly, with the following words.
examples.gold_sn: तं समीक्ष्यागतं रामं सुग्रीवः सहलक्ष्मणम्। ह्वीमान् दीनमुवाचेदं वसुधामवलोकयन्॥

examples.query: Alas! you are lying on this bed of the heroes, being slain in the battle, where formerly, your enemies destroyed by you, used to lie down,
examples.gold_sn: इदं तद् वीरशयनं तत्र शेषे हतो युधि ॥ शायिता निहता यत्र त्वयैव रिपवः पुरा।

examples.query: O Lakşmaņa, what is the use of help to him the sounds of whose stretching bow made the Earth tremble with her mountains?
examples.gold_sn: धनुर्विस्फारमाणस्य यस्य शब्देन लक्ष्मण। सशैला कम्पिता भूमिः सहायैः किं नु तस्य वै॥

examples.query: In all these mountain fastnesses, cascades and woods, do you together search for the renowned wife of Rama.
examples.gold_sn: एतेषां गिरिदुर्गेषु प्रपातेषु वनेषु च। मार्गध्वं सहिताः सर्वे रामपत्नी यशस्विनीम्॥

examples.query: Searched have been all the mountains, and deep woods, and streams, and islands embosomed in the ocean, and the various provinces. And also searched have been all the caves which have been described by you; and searched have been all the groves entertwined with plants; and thickets; and difficult and uneven grounds. And huge animals have been sought out and slain (by us). And all the impracticable places we have explored again and again.
examples.gold_sn: विचिताः पर्वताः सर्वे वनानि गहनानि च। निम्नगाः सागरान्ताश्च सर्वे जनपदाश्च ये॥ गुहाश्च विचिता सर्वे याश्च ते परिकीर्तिताः। विचिताश्च महागुल्मा लताविततसंतताः॥ गहनेषु च देशेषु दुर्गेषु विषमेषु च। सत्वान्यतिप्रमाणानि विचितानि हतानि च। ये चैव गहना देशा विचितास्ते पुनः पुनः॥

examples.query: Those who act, for certain behold the fruit of their endeavours; but if people once give way to grief, they cannot again attain vigour.
examples.gold_sn: अवश्यं कुर्वतां तस्य दृश्यते कर्मणः फलम्। परं निर्वेदमागम्य नहि नोन्मीलनं क्षमम्॥

examples.query: Let us enter here', said I to the monkeys. And they also arrived at that conclusion.* And thereupon they, bestirring themselves, entered into the cave. And firmly griping each other's hands, they at once made entry into the cave covered with darkness. This is our errand; and it is on this job that we have come. *Namely, that water was to be found there.
examples.gold_sn: साध्वत्र प्रविशामेति मया तूक्ताः प्लवङ्गमाः। तेषामपि ह सर्वेषामनुमानमुपागतम्॥ अस्मिन् निपतिताः सर्वेऽप्यथ कार्यत्वरान्विताः। ततो गाढं निपतिता गृह्य हस्तैः परस्परम्॥ इदं प्रविष्टाः सहसा बिलं तिमिरसंवृतम्। . एतन्नः कार्यमेतेन कृत्येन वयमागताः॥

examples.query: Then they, eagerly desirous of going out, closed their sight* with their hands furnished with tender fingers. *The text has nimilitah—and thus they closed their eyes. This redundant epithet has been left out in the translation, as it would render the version extremely awkward.
examples.gold_sn: ततो निमीलिताः सर्वे सुकुमाराङ्गुलैः करैः॥ सहसा पिदधुदृष्टिं हृष्टा गमनकाझ्या ।

examples.query: I vow before you, to the palace I will never repair. At this very spot will I fast for death; as death is good for me.
examples.gold_sn: अहं वः प्रतिजानामि न गमिष्याम्यहं पुरीम् । इहैव प्रायमासिष्ये श्रेयो मरणमेव मे॥

examples.query: All the monkeys are depressed. O Hanuman, did you overlook this? Put forth your you endowed with mighty vehemence, like Vişnu sing over the three worlds in three steps.
examples.gold_sn: विषण्णा हरयः सर्वे हनुमन् किमुपेक्षसे। विक्रमस्व महावेग विष्णुस्त्रीन् विक्रमानिव ॥

examples.query: Well developed; having equal and elegant parts; with hard joints; fraught with strength; with thumbs having nails bearing auspicious marks; having rings (on the fingers); covered; formed like bludgeons; round; resembling the trunks of elephants; cast on the white bed like to five-hooded serpents;
examples.gold_sn: पीनौ समसुजातांसौ संगतौ बलसंयुतौ । सुलक्षणनखाङ्गुष्ठौ स्वङ्गुलीयकलक्षितौ ॥ संवृतौ परिघाकारौ वृत्तौ करिकरोपमौ। विक्षिप्तौ शयने शुभ्रे पञ्चशीर्षाविवोरगौ॥

examples.query: She was like to Smrti of doubtful meanings, fallen wealth, lost respect, hope without any desire for gain, Siddhis of many troubles, sullied understanding and fame soiled with false rumours.
examples.gold_sn: तां स्मृतीमिव च संदिग्धामृद्धिं निपतितामिव। विहतामिव च श्रद्धामाशां प्रतिहतामिव ॥ सोपसर्गां यथा सिद्धिं बुद्धिं सकलुषामिव। अभूतेनापवादेन कीर्तिं निपतितामिव॥

examples.query: O sportive damsel, for your satisfaction, I shall conquer the whole earth, engarlanded by many cities and bestow it upon Janaka.
examples.gold_sn: विजित्य पृथिवीं सर्वां नानानगरमालिनीम्। जनकाय प्रदास्यामि तव हेतोर्विलासिनि॥

examples.query: Methinks Rāma dose not know that I am here, or else, powerful as he is, he would not have put up with this insult.
examples.gold_sn: इहस्थां मां न जानीते शङ्के लक्ष्मणपूर्वजः। जानन्नपि स तेजस्वी धर्षणां मर्षयिष्यति ॥

examples.query: Or those two brothers, the foremost of men, laying aside their weapons, and living on fruits and roots, have been wandering in the forest.
examples.gold_sn: अथवा न्यस्तशस्त्रौ तौ वने मूलफलाशनौ। भ्रातरौ हि नरश्रेष्ठौ चरन्तौ वनगोचरौ॥

examples.query: At length my watchful eyes have seen her, whom have been seeking in vain, the thousands and millions of the monkeys in all directions and quarters.
examples.gold_sn: यां कपीनां सहस्राणि सुबहून्ययुतानि च। दिक्षु सर्वासु मार्गन्ते सेयमासादिता मया॥

examples.query: What ordinary man can come here crossing the incomparable ocean.
examples.gold_sn: प्राकृतोऽन्यः कथं चेमां भूमिमागन्तुमर्हति। उदधेरप्रमेयस्य पारं वानरयूथप॥

examples.query: But even if you go (passing today here), I have, O tiger-like monkey, doubts as to your return; and, accordingly, doubt, certainly, as to my life.
examples.gold_sn: ततो हि हरिशार्दूल पुनरागमनाय तु। प्राणानामपि संदेहो मम स्यान्नात्र संशयः॥

examples.query: He directed five of the foremost leaders of his forces, the heroic Virūpaksa Yupakşa, the Rāks asa Durdharsa, Praghasa, and Bhasakarma, versed in polity, endowed with the speed of the Wind in conflict and alert on every occasion, to take Hanumān captive.
examples.gold_sn: स विरूपाक्षयूपाक्षौ दुर्धर्षं चैव राक्षसम्। प्रघसं भासकर्णं च पञ्चसेनाग्रनायकान्॥ संदिदेश दशग्रीवो वीरान् नयविशारदान्। हनूमद्ग्रहणे व्यग्रान्वायुवेगसमान्युधि ॥

examples.query: The dreadful yells of mighty lions in pain, inhabiting caves, entered the car, piercing the heavens. And Vidyādharis with their attires falling off and their ornaments disordered, suddenly rose from the mountain to the sky. (Dharanidharāt-at-from the holder of the Earth, the latter being supposed to rest on a mountain)
examples.gold_sn: कन्दरोदरसंस्थानां पीडितानां महौजसाम्। सिंहानां निनदो भीमो नभो भिन्दन् हि शुश्रुवे॥ त्रस्तव्याविद्धवसना व्याकुलीकृतभूषणाः। विद्याधर्यः समुत्पेतुः सहसा धरणीधरात्॥

examples.query: Desisting from their unavailing railing, the flesh-feasting Rākṣasi imparted to Rivaņa the mighty intent of Sītā.
examples.gold_sn: वृथा गर्जितनिश्चेष्टा राक्षस्यः पिशिताशनाः। रावणाय शशंसुस्ताः सीताव्यवसितं महत्॥

examples.query: Propitiated by our bowing down, Janaka's daughter, Maithili, shall rescue the Raksasis from a mighty fear."
examples.gold_sn: प्रणिपातप्रसन्ना हि मैथिली जनकात्मजा॥ अलमेषा परित्रातुं राक्षस्यो महतो भयात्।

examples.query: While I reflecting thus, being overwhelmed with grief, I heard the auspicious was accents of the Caranas, exciting my wonder, Jänaki has not been burnt down.
examples.gold_sn: इति शोकसमाविष्टश्चिन्तामहमुपागतः। ततोऽहं वाचमश्रौषं चारणानां शुभाक्षराम्॥ जानकी न च दग्धेति विस्मयोदन्तभाषिणाम्।

examples.query: O great monkey, O you of best understanding, what you had spoken, is, I think) not proper, for we have been despatched by them to ransack the southern quarter, but we have not been commanded by the king of the monkeys and the highly intelligent Rāma to bring her.
examples.gold_sn: नैषा बुद्धिर्महाबुद्धे यद् ब्रवीषि महाकपे। विचेतुं वयमाज्ञप्ता दक्षिणां दिशमुत्तमाम्॥ नानेतुं कपिराजेन नैव रामेण धीमता।

examples.query: And overwhelmed with fright, and quaking (for fear), the creatures began to measure their lengths, and they were sore afflicted, and bereft of motion through terror.
examples.gold_sn: शिश्यिरे चाभिभूतानि संत्रस्तान्युद्विजन्ति च॥ संप्रविव्यथिरे चापि न च पस्पन्दिरे भयात्।

examples.query: O worst of Rākşasas, do you display that prowess of your by which, aided by your power of illusion, you have forcible carried off Sītā, disregarding me.
examples.gold_sn: बलेन येन वै सीतां मायया राक्षसाधम। मामतिक्रमयित्वा त्वं हृतवांस्तनिदर्शय॥

examples.query: And witnessing that mighty exploit of the foremost of the monkeys, Akampana waxed furious with wrath.
examples.gold_sn: तदृष्ट्वा सुमहत्कर्म कृतं वानरसत्तमैः। क्रोधमाहारयामास युधि तीव्रमकम्पनः॥

examples.query: I shall crush the mountains and rive the earth. And today let all creatures as they are being eaten up, witness the prowess of Kumbhakarņa, after he has slept for a long time. Even the celestial regions do not suffice for me as my fare.
examples.gold_sn: पर्वतांचूर्णयिष्यामि दारयिष्यामि मेदिनीम्॥ दीर्घकालं प्रसुप्तस्य कुम्भकर्णस्य विक्रमम्। अद्य पश्यन्तु भूतानि भक्ष्यमाणानि सर्वशः।। न त्विदं त्रिदिवं सर्वमाहारो मम पूर्यते॥

examples.query: And all those mountain-tops he cut off with his dart; and the mighty Kumbhakarņa also baffled the shower of trees.
examples.gold_sn: तानि पर्वतशृङ्गाणि शूलेन स बिभेद ह। बभञ्ज वृक्षवर्षं च कुम्भकर्णो महाबलः॥

examples.query: Narāntaka mounted a white steed resembling Uccaiḥśravă, caparisoned in gold, having a large frame and endowed with the velocity of the wind.
examples.gold_sn: हयमुच्चैःश्रवःप्रख्यं श्वेतं कनकभूषणम्। मनोजवं महाकायमारुरोह नरान्तकः॥

examples.query: Mahodara, getting enraged, again swiftly mounted an elephant like the ray-furnished (Sun) mounting Mandara.
examples.gold_sn: महोदरस्तु संक्रुद्धः कुञ्जरं पर्वतोपमम्। भूयः समधिरुह्याशु मन्दरं रश्मिवानिव॥

examples.query: On that sharp-headed best of arrows being fixed on that foremost of weapons, the cardinal quarters and the Moon and the sun and the mighty planets and the sky were saized with affright; and the earth shook.
examples.gold_sn: तस्मिन्वरास्त्रे तु नियुज्यमाने सौमित्रिणा बाणवरे शिताओ। दिशश्च चन्द्रार्कमहाग्रहाश्च नभश्च तत्रास ररास चोर्वी॥

examples.query: That invincible hero in that conflict mangled the monkeys with shafts resembling the Sun, decked with gold.
examples.gold_sn: स शरैः सूर्यसंकाशैः शातकुम्भविभूषणैः। वानरान्समरे वीरः प्रममाथ सुदुर्जयः॥

examples.query: The twang of Rama's bow, drowning the roars of both the monkeys and die Rákşasas: was alone heard.
examples.gold_sn: उद्देष्टं वानराणां च राक्षसानां च निःस्वनम्। ज्याशब्दस्तावुभौ शब्दावतिरामस्य शुश्रुवे॥

examples.query: Then the monkeys hemmed in the Rākşasaforces, with their apparels falling off and with their mail and standards strewn around.
examples.gold_sn: विप्रलम्बितवस्त्रं च विमुक्तकवचध्वजम्। बलं राक्षसमालम्ब्य वानराः पर्यवारयन्॥

examples.query: Hearing the words of Rāvana, Khara's son, Makarākşa, proud of his own own prowess, delightedly spoke to the night-ranger, saying, “Be it so." And saluting and circumambulating the ten-necked one, that hero, at Ravana's behest, issued out of the house.
examples.gold_sn: रावणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा शूरमानी खरात्मजः। बाढमित्यब्रवीद्धृष्टो मकराक्षो निशाचरम्॥ सोऽभिवाद्य दशग्रीवं कृत्वा चापि प्रदक्षिणम्। निर्जगाम गृहाच्छुभ्राद्रावणस्याज्ञया बली ॥

examples.query: Thereupon Ravana, beside himself with anger, laughing, addressed those Raksasas, Mahodara, Mahāpārsva, and Virūpākşa, saying.
examples.gold_sn: ततोवाच प्रहस्यैतान्रावणः क्रोधमूर्च्छितः। महोदरमहापार्टी विरूपाक्षं च राक्षसम्॥

examples.query: Thereupon the night-ranger Mahodara, inflamed with ire, hurled at Sugrīva, the club flaming like the Sun.
examples.gold_sn: ततः क्रुद्धो गदां तस्य चिक्षेप रजनीचरः। ज्वलन्ती भास्कराभासां सुग्रीवाय महोदरः॥

examples.query: The Rākşasa, with his weapons assailed the dreadful army of Angada as well as the leading monkeys. The Rākşasa severed the heads from the bodies of the monkeys like to the wind throwing away the fruits from trees. were
examples.gold_sn: अङ्गदस्य चमू भीमा क्षोभयामास मार्गणैः। स वानराणां मुख्यानामुत्तमाङ्गानि राक्षसः॥ पातयामास कायेभ्यः फलं वृन्तादिवानिलः।

examples.query: There appeared beautiful at the battle-field Rāma of firm promise, slaying his enemy and encircled by his army and friends like to the lord of the celestials surrounded by the gods.
examples.gold_sn: स तु निहतरिपुः स्थिरप्रतिज्ञः स्वजनबलाभिवृतो रणे बभूव। स्त्रिदशगणैरभिसंवृतो महेन्द्रः॥

examples.query: Besides success in battle is not perpetual; either one slays his enemy or meets with his destruction at his hands in the conflict.
examples.gold_sn: नैकान्तविजयो युद्धे भूतपूर्वः कदाचन। परैर्वा हन्यते वीरः परान्वा हन्ति संयुगे॥

examples.query: O gentle on obtaining permission from the king Bibhshana, do you enter the city of Lankā and enquire after Maithili's welfare.
examples.gold_sn: अनुज्ञाप्य महाराजमिमं सौम्य विभीषणम्। प्रविश्य नगरी लङ्कां कौशलं ब्रूहि मैथिलीम्॥

examples.query: You should know, from the colour of his countenance, his looks and his words, all the movements and actions of Bharata.
examples.gold_sn: ज्ञेयाः सर्वे च वृत्तान्ता भरतस्येङ्गितानि च। तत्त्वेन मुखवणेन दृष्ट्या व्याभाषितेन च॥

examples.query: Entering the huge and excellent golden palace Ravana consoled Maithili with (diverse) words.
examples.gold_sn: तां सुवर्णपरिष्कारे शुभे महति वेश्मनि॥ प्रवेश्य मैथिली वाक्यैः सान्त्वयामास रावणः।

examples.query: Then went Sītā and all the wives of Sugrīva decorated with all ornaments and wearing excellent Kundalas, anxious to behold the city.
examples.gold_sn: सर्वाभरणजुष्टाश्च ययुस्ताः शुभकुण्डलाः। सुग्रीवपत्न्यः सीता च द्रष्टुं नगरमुत्सुकाः॥

examples.query: Vibhīşaņa, the lord of Rākşasas standing on one side, took up the white Chowrie shining like the second moon.
examples.gold_sn: श्वेतं च बालव्यजनं जगृहे परितः स्थितः। अपरं चन्द्रसंकाशं राक्षसेन्द्रो विभीषणः॥

examples.query: That head of lord of Rākşasas, terrific to behold, on being cut off (by Visnu), vomiting blood, fell down before (the Rākşasas), as formerly Rahu's head had fallen.
examples.gold_sn: तच्छिरो राक्षसेन्द्रस्य चक्रोत्कृत्तं बिभीषणम्। पपात रुधिरोद्गारि पुरा राहुशिरो यथा।॥

examples.query: They, all afflicted, shed tears, hot as fiery flames, caused by fear and fire of grief. As the ocean is filled with the currents of the rivers so that car was flooded with their tears originating from fear and sorrow.
examples.gold_sn: ता हि सर्वाः समं दुःखान्मुमुचुर्बाष्पजं जलम्। तुल्यमवयर्चिषां तत्र शोकाग्निभयसंभवम्॥ ताभिः सर्वानवद्याभिनंदीभिरिव सागरः। आपूरितं विमानं तद्भयशोकाशिवाश्रुभिः॥

examples.query: Rambhā appeared like the second tree, in grace and beauty, natural and artificial. She was seen by Rāvana as proceeding in the midst of soldiers.

examples.query: Recollecting the evil advice of the old king and some deeds of his, Bhima, one days, in the midst of his friends, slapped his armpits, in the hearing of Dhritarashtra and of Gandhari. The angry Vrikodara, recollecting his enemies Duyrodhana and Karna and Dushasana, gave way to a fit of passion, and said these harsh words :-'The sons of the blind king, capable of fighting with various kinds of weapons, have all been dispatched by me to the other world with these arms of mine which resemble a pair of iron clubs.
examples.gold_sn: स्मरन् दुर्मन्त्रितं तस्य वृत्तान्यप्यस्य कानिचित्। अथ भीमः सुहृन्मध्ये बाहुशब्दं तथाकरोत्॥ संश्रवे धृतराष्ट्रस्य गान्धार्याश्चाप्यमर्षणः। स्मृत्वा दुर्योधनं शत्रु कर्णदुःशासनावपि॥ प्रोवाचेदं सुरंब्धो भीमः स परुषं वचः।

examples.gold_sn: नान्वबुध्यत तद् राजा कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः॥ श्वेताश्वो वाथ कुन्ती वा द्रौपदी वा यशस्विनी। माद्रीपुत्रौ च धर्मज्ञौ चित्तं तस्यान्ववर्तताम्॥

examples.query: You are, O son of Kunti, cndued with intelligence and learning. Listen to me, O king, I tell you what the means are by which, O son of Pandu, the kingdom is capable of being righteously protected.
examples.gold_sn: तत्त शक्यं महाराज रक्षितुं पाण्डुनन्दन। राज्यं धर्मेण कौन्तेय विद्वानसि निबोध तत्॥

examples.query: Bearing in their hearts, from which every other thoughts had been removed, the sorrow born of Dhritarashtra's desire to leave the world, they looked like men shorn of consciousness.
examples.gold_sn: हृदयैः शून्यभूतैस्ते धृतराष्ट्रप्रवासजम्। दुःखं संधारयन्तो हि नष्टसंज्ञा इवाभवन्॥

examples.query: Seeing, however, the son of Virata's daughter, viz., your sire Parikshit, your grandsires somehow lived.
examples.gold_sn: वैराट्यास्तनयं दृष्ट्वा पितरं ते परिक्षितम्। धारयन्ति स्म ते प्राणांस्तव पूर्वपितामहाः॥

examples.query: Let carriages and granaries and wardrobes, and treasuries, be equipt and ordered out, and let mechanics have ihe command to march out. Let men in charge of treasuries go out on the way leading to the ascetic hermitage of Kurukshetra.
examples.gold_sn: शकटापणवेशाश्च कोशः शिल्पिन एव च। निर्यान्तु कोषपालाश्च कुरुक्षेत्राश्रमं प्रति॥

examples.query: O chief of Bharata's race, I shall unite you also with great benefit. Know, O son, that I am come here for removing your doubts.
examples.gold_sn: त्वां चापि श्रेयसा योक्ष्ये न चिराद् भरतर्षभ। संशयच्छेदनार्थाय प्राप्तं मां विद्धि पुत्रका॥

examples.query: Thus addressed by Vyasa of incomparable energy, the Kuru king, well versed in words summoned Yudhishthira and said to him, 'O you having no enemies, blessing on you! Do you listen to me, with all your brothers! Through your grace, O king, grief no longer stands in my way.
examples.gold_sn: इत्युक्तः कौरवो राजा व्यासेनातुलतेजसा। युधिष्ठिरमथाहूय वाग्मी वचनमब्रवीत्॥ अजातशत्रो भद्रं ते शृणु मे भ्रातृभिः सह। त्वत्प्रसादान्महीपाल शोको नास्मान् प्रबाधते॥

examples.query: FINISH AHSRAN The great Rishi Narada, having comforted king Yudhishthira of righteous soul, went away to where he liked.
examples.gold_sn: समाश्वास्य तु राजानं धर्मात्मानं युधिष्ठिरम्। नारदोऽप्यगमद् राजन् परमर्षिर्यथेप्सितम्॥

examples.query: When Brahmanas, receiving gifts, blessed the day or the hour fixed for this or that undertaking or when great men were engaged in silent recitations, the heavy trend was heard of many men running about but no one could be seen to whom the sound of such sound could be ascribed.
examples.gold_sn: पुण्याहे वाच्यमाने तु जपत्सु च महात्मसु। अभिधावन्तः श्रूयन्ते न चादृश्यत कश्चन॥

examples.query: A loud and heart-rendering sound of wailing was heard in Vasudeva's palace, uttered by the weeping ladies.
examples.gold_sn: ततः शब्दो महानासीद् वसुदेवनिवेशने। दारुणः क्रोशतीनां च रुदतीनां च योषिताम्॥
